A few good ones from this week:

  • The "Skip Intro" button should show up far more often on TV episodes — we found and fixed a setting that was quietly limiting it.
  • Fixed an audio glitch where a few titles could default to the wrong language track; English wins by default now, like it should.
  • Cleared up a rare snag that could get some downloads stuck in a retry loop, so new arrivals show up faster.
  • Ironed out some broken links in the request system that popped up when browsing on a phone.

Thanks for streaming with us! 🎬
